entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way to the restaurant."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way to the restaurant.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci (R)
entries.title: Deivid Wisci (R): ""King Romus, what an honor to meet..."
entries.dialogueText: "King Romus, what an honor to meet you. I'm Deivid Wisci, Foreign Minister of Sordland. Allow me to introduce President Anton Rayne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Laurento and I were debating the..."
entries.dialogueText: As Laurento and I were debating the merits of the pasta selection, a gentleman with a kindly demeanor approached us.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci (R)
entries.title: Deivid Wisci (R): ""A splendid idea, Laurento. Let's f..."
entries.dialogueText: "A splendid idea, Laurento. Let's find a spot where we can talk more comfortably."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Minister Wisci, President Rayne, i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Minister Wisci, President Rayne, it's an honor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pleasure to meet you both.""
entries.dialogueText: "Pleasure to meet you both."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Your Majesty, it's a pleasure. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, it's a pleasure. And Minister Wisci is too kind – the honor is mine. It's good to meet new faces."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""President Rayne, Minister Wisci, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne, Minister Wisci, welcome. Let's hope our chat is more satisfying than the lunch selection."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Minister Wisci, President Rayne, s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Minister Wisci, President Rayne, shall we take a seat? It might be more conducive for our discussion."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Very glad we ran into each other...."
entries.dialogueText: "Very glad we ran into each other. Always good to see you Deivid and Mr. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We moved towards a quieter section..."
entries.dialogueText: We moved towards a quieter section of the room, finding a round table that seemed perfect for a more intimate dialogue. We sat down and arranged our plates.

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""It seems we're all victims of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems we're all victims of the culinary experiments at this year's conference. I hope the AN general assembly coming up soon will have a better offering."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One can only hope, President Rayne..."
entries.dialogueText: "One can only hope, President Rayne. The stakes at the general assembly are certainly higher than our lunch choices here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed, President Rayne. If the ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, President Rayne. If the general assembly is as varied and unpredictable as this buffet, we're in for an interesting time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They might need some Rizian chefs..."
entries.dialogueText: "They might need some Rizian chefs here, or maybe Sordish ones. Our cuisines do have a reputation for excellence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We had much more important things..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had much more important things than some food talk I think."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Direct and to the point, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Direct and to the point, Your Majesty. I appreciate that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We moved towards a quieter section..."
entries.dialogueText: We moved towards a quieter section of the room, finding a round table that seemed perfect for a more intimate dialogue. As we sat down, arranging our plates, President Rayne casually addressed the group, lightening the mood.

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Don't forget the delights of Sordi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget the delights of Sordish cuisine, Your Majesty. Have you ever tried Svabli? It's a Holsord specialty - sheep cheese like you've never tasted it before."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Absolutely, King Romus. Yet, somet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely, King Romus. Yet, sometimes, these small talks can be a prelude to greater discussions. Like our Zabla back in Bergia, simple on the surface but complex beneath."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""An interesting analogy. Much like..."
entries.dialogueText: "An interesting analogy. Much like our traditional Sordish stew, I suppose. Simple ingredients coming together to create something substantial."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Svabli, you say? I must admit, my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Svabli, you say? I must admit, my experience with Sordish cuisine is limited, but I'm always open to new culinary adventures."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Svabli... I've heard of it but nev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Svabli... I've heard of it but never had the pleasure. It seems our diplomatic meetings could benefit from a taste of Sordland's finest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I haven't tried Svabli yet, Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't tried Svabli yet, President Rayne. But it's always fascinating to talk to a food afficionado."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Traditional Sordish stew? I like t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Traditional Sordish stew? I like the blend of various elements, each adding its own unique flavor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your stew analogy is quite fitting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your stew analogy is quite fitting. It's about harmony among different ingredients."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I like the sound of that stew – it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the sound of that stew – it's a reminder that something greater than the sum of its parts can emerge from simple beginnings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is Zabla made of? I'm curious.""
entries.dialogueText: "What is Zabla made of? I'm curious."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zabla's simplicity yet underlying..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zabla's simplicity yet underlying complexity is intriguing. It's a bit like our Rizetta, a breakfast dish that seems simple but offers a depth of flavors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Zabla analogy is thought-provo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Zabla analogy is thought-provoking. Never knew you cared so much about dishes, isn't Lespia the big culinary nation in East Merkopa?"

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Oh it is super tasty, much better..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh it is super tasty, much better than the pasta we are having here today."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""I will see to it that you do next..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will see to it that you do next time you visit."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Food reflects a nation's culture –..."
entries.dialogueText: "Food reflects a nation's culture – robust and full of character, much like Sordland itself."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I think we can gather for culinary..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we can gather for culinary debates at another occassion, timing and proportion are critical. It's not just what we bring to the table, but how and when we present it."
